news.title: Fed's rate hike push may be a mistake. Here's why
news.summary: Experts argue that the Fed is looking at the wrong data as it pushes for more interest-rate hikes, with falling gasoline and energy prices suggesting inflation pressures are already easing.

news.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
news.summary: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.
